hooks.name: PreCommit
hooks.description: Deterministic validation running before commits are finalized, checking commit message formatting, linting rules, tests, coverage floor, and security scans.

commands.name: Check Commit Message Format
commands.errorMessage: Commit message does not match the mandatory traceability convention. Expected format: type(scope): summary [Rn] (#issue_id)

commands.name: Lint Check
commands.errorMessage: Linter failed. Zero formatting or syntactic errors are permitted in production-grade code.

commands.name: Unit Tests & Coverage
commands.errorMessage: Unit tests failed or overall statement/branch coverage is below the required 90% threshold.

commands.name: Security Vulnerability Scan
commands.errorMessage: Trivy security engine detected HIGH or CRITICAL severity vulnerabilities in dependency trees or local workspace.

hooks.name: PreToolUse
hooks.description: Interprets tool usage permissions and blocks destructive actions or modifications to sealed files.

commands.name: Block Destructive DB Commands
commands.errorMessage: Tool execution blocked: Sandboxed write credentials prohibit executing high-risk mutations (DROP, DELETE, TRUNCATE).

hooks.name: OnInterrupt
hooks.description: Triggered when active execution is interrupted by environment anomalies or critical configuration voids.

actions.message: EXECUTION PAUSED: A critical API key, secret, or environment variable is missing. Halting execution loop for manual override.

hooks.name: OnCircuitBreaker
hooks.description: Triggered when iterative code repairs or unit testing loops reach the hard limit of 5 failed attempts.

actions.message: CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED: Automated repair failed to resolve issues in 5 attempts. Restoring stable branch and triggering manual takeover.

hooks.name: OnArchitectureDrift
hooks.description: Triggers alert or block when proposed changes modify contracts inside docs/architecture.md without authorization.

actions.message: CRITICAL DRIFT DETECTED: Directly modifying docs/architecture.md is prohibited outside the formal architectural arbitration. Please run /arch-gate.
